testName: Lightning Dashboard Creation with Dynamic Metric Gauges & Global Filters
steps:
1. Open Dashboards tab
2. Click on "New Dashboard" button
3. Enter Dashboard Name "Q3 Sales Performance Cockpit" and save
4. Click "+ Component" button and select report "Executive Win Rate by Quarter"
5. Select Display As "Gauge Chart" with Breakpoints: Red (0-40%), Yellow (40-70%), Green (70-100%)
6. Click Add Component
7. Click "+ Filter" button to add Global Filter by "Opportunity Owner / Territory"
8. Click "Save" and click "Done" to view live dashboard
9. Select Global Filter "EMEA Territory"
10. Verify gauge and bar chart recalculate dynamically based on selected filter without page reload
